subject.title: feat(sessions): upstream liveness for adopted catalog sessions

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this additive SessionCatalogProvider upstream-probing API, durable link table, and re-continue-only no-backfill behavior as the v1 core contract once the cross-agent defects are fixed?
rationale: This changes the public plugin SDK and persisted session model, while the canonical issue is explicitly awaiting product direction and the PR has a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Approve repaired v1

options.title: Restrict global scope
